scope: Independent recorded-frame, hash, settings, coverage and ranking audit. No interpreter or agent reruns.

ranking_spec.head_to_head_rule: For every group tied on overall strict wins, compare strict wins divided by all planned games against the other members of that original tie group. Two-way ties use their direct 32 games. Do not recompute smaller tie groups recursively.
ranking_spec.worst_opponent_rule: Minimum strict win rate across all seven opponents, using each full 32-game denominator.
ranking_spec.errors: Not wins; do not reduce denominators. The unchanged harness marks candidates with incomplete valid coverage ineligible for ranking.
ranking_spec.eligibility: Require the independent round-robin audit to pass; only candidates with all 224 valid completed games and intact source identities are eligible. Require at least two eligible candidates before selection.
ranking_spec.selection: Take the first two eligible candidates in the total order.
ranking_spec.cash: No cash tie-break or cash acceptance gate in this round robin.
ranking_spec.source: ROUND_01_PLAN.md: strict win rate, then head-to-head results, then worst-opponent rate. Candidate ID only resolves otherwise exact equality.

limits: All planned games remain in strict-win denominators; draws and errors are not wins.
Cash is descriptive and is not a ranking criterion.
This round robin selects candidates; it does not establish fixed-pool competitive acceptance.
